question: What is the stronger approach for executing untrusted Lua scripts?
options: Use a purpose-built isolated runner with explicit capability restrictions and CPU/memory/time limits
Only remove print from the globals
Run it in the main web server process
Trust any script stored in a table
answer_key: Use a purpose-built isolated runner with explicit capability restrictions and CPU/memory/time limits
explanation: A secure design needs a threat model, exposed capability restrictions, isolation boundaries and enforced resource limits; an empty-looking environment alone is insufficient.
